name: any-lover-workspace
description: Any-Lover（角色 Charis）桌宠版 AI 伴侣工作区：apps/desktop（Electron 外壳+Pet 模式）、apps/settings-ui（React 设置面板）、build/scripts（后端组装与冻结）。
author: ai-bot

scripts.install:app: npm --prefix apps/settings-ui install && npm --prefix apps/desktop install
scripts.install:all: npm run install:app && npm --prefix apps/site install
scripts.dev:setup: npm run install:app && npm run prepare-runtime && npm run settings:build
scripts.dev: npm run prepare-runtime && npm run settings:build && npm run desktop:dev
scripts.site:dev: npm --prefix apps/site run sync:live2d && npm --prefix apps/site run dev
scripts.site:build: npm --prefix apps/site run sync:live2d && npm --prefix apps/site run build
scripts.dist: npm run prepare-runtime && npm run build:backend && npm run pack
scripts.dist:full: npm run prepare-runtime && npm run build:backend && npm run pack:full
